title: 灭火器的使用与检查
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/033_灭火器的使用与检查.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/033_灭火器的使用与检查/src.py

points.K1: 先培训，人人会用灭火器
points.K2: 听老师安排，自己也要会
points.K5: 对准火焰根部，左右扫射
points.K6: 一具灭火器只能喷很短时间
points.K7: 保持安全距离，站在上风
points.K8: 背对出口，退路留在身后
points.K9: 二氧化碳灭火器：防冻伤，防窒息
points.K10: 扑不灭就撤，生命高于财产
points.K12: 放在明处，不挡不挪，用后更换

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一具训练灭火器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a red training fire extinguisher and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲灭火器的使用与检查。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 废纸篓冒起小火，阿杰拿起灭火器却不知所措
shots.prompt_en: A small fire starts in a waste bin; the young male student grabs an extinguisher but looks confused.
shots.narration: 纸篓起了小火，阿杰拿起灭火器愣住了。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰对着火苗顶部乱喷，压把没压下
shots.prompt_en: He points the nozzle at the top of the flames and fumbles with the handle; nothing comes out.
shots.narration: 销子没拔，喷嘴也对错了地方。

shots.section_title: 先培训，人人会用灭火器
shots.scene: 王老师带学生在训练场练习灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator leads students practicing with training extinguishers at an outdoor training area.
shots.narration: 灭火器要先经过培训才会用。
overlay: 先培训，人人会用灭火器

shots.section_title: 先培训，人人会用灭火器
shots.scene: 学生轮流用训练灭火器，王老师点头
shots.prompt_en: Students take turns with a training extinguisher while the safety administrator nods.
shots.narration: 实验室里人人都要会用。

shots.section_title: 先培训，人人会用灭火器
shots.scene: 平时练习和紧急时冷静操作的对比
shots.prompt_en: Left: a student practicing calmly; right: the same student acting calmly in an emergency. No text.
shots.narration: 平时多练，紧张时才不会乱。

shots.section_title: 听老师安排，自己也要会
shots.scene: 实验室起火，王老师拿灭火器，学生站在后面
shots.prompt_en: A small lab fire; the safety administrator takes the extinguisher while students stand back.
shots.narration: 实验室起火，一般由老师来扑救。
overlay: 听老师安排，自己也要会

shots.section_title: 听老师安排，自己也要会
shots.scene: 王老师指挥：一人报警、一人疏散
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points: one student to the phone, another to guide people out.
shots.narration: 该做什么，听老师安排。

shots.section_title: 听老师安排，自己也要会
shots.scene: 小研独自在实验室，也会用灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, alone in the lab, confidently picks up an extinguisher.
shots.narration: 你自己也要会用，以防万一。

shots.section_title: 动手前先问三个问题
shots.scene: 小研面对小火，头顶三个问号图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student faces a small fire with three question mark icons above her. No text.
shots.narration: 动手灭火前，先问三个问题。

shots.section_title: 动手前先问三个问题
shots.scene: 浓烟、身后堵住、灭火器不对路三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three warning icons: thick toxic smoke, a blocked exit behind, the wrong extinguisher type. No text.
shots.narration: 有一个答不上来，就撤离报警。

shots.section_title: 动手前先问三个问题
shots.scene: 人已撤开、火很小，才拿起灭火器
shots.prompt_en: People have moved away and the fire is small; only then does she lift the extinguisher.
shots.narration: 人撤开了，又是小火，再去扑救。

shots.section_title: 动手前先问三个问题
shots.scene: 电器火先拉闸，金属火不泼水
shots.prompt_en: A hand switches off the main power for an electrical fire; water on burning metal is crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 电器火先断电，金属火别用水。

shots.section_title: 使用四步：提、拔、握、压
shots.scene: 四个步骤图标：提、拔、握、压
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons in a row: lifting, pulling a pin, holding a hose, pressing a handle. No text.
shots.narration: 用灭火器记住四步：提、拔、握、压。

shots.section_title: 使用四步：提、拔、握、压
shots.scene: 【实拍】手握提把提起训练灭火器，屈膝起身（训练灭火器，中景）
shots.prompt_en: A person bends the knees and lifts a fire extinguisher by its carrying handle.
shots.narration: 第一步，提：握住提把，提起灭火器。

shots.section_title: 使用四步：提、拔、握、压
shots.scene: 【实拍】拔掉保险销，铅封随之断开（训练灭火器，手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand pulling the safety pin out of an extinguisher handle, breaking the seal.
shots.narration: 第二步，拔：拔掉保险销。

shots.section_title: 使用四步：提、拔、握、压
shots.scene: 【实拍】一手握住喷管，对准前方地面目标（训练灭火器，手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of one hand holding the hose nozzle and aiming it forward and low.
shots.narration: 第三步，握：一手握住喷管。

shots.section_title: 使用四步：提、拔、握、压
shots.scene: 【实拍】另一手用力压下压把（训练灭火器，不喷放，手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the other hand squeezing the extinguisher handle firmly.
shots.narration: 第四步，压：用力压下压把。

shots.section_title: 使用四步：提、拔、握、压
shots.scene: 国外口诀和国内口诀两张卡片，用等号连接
shots.prompt_en: Two blank cards linked by an equals sign, each with four step icons. No text.
shots.narration: 国外口诀四步，意思相同。

shots.section_title: 对准火焰根部，左右扫射
shots.scene: 喷嘴对准火焰根部，火焰熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The extinguisher nozzle aims at the base of the flames and the fire goes out. No faces.
shots.narration: 喷嘴对准火焰根部。
overlay: 对准火焰根部，左右扫射

shots.section_title: 对准火焰根部，左右扫射
shots.scene: 对着火苗顶部喷射，火不灭，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Spraying at the top of the flames while the base keeps burning, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 喷火苗顶部，灭不了火源。

shots.section_title: 对准火焰根部，左右扫射
shots.scene: 压住压把，从近到远左右扫射
shots.prompt_en: Powder sweeps side to side across the fire base, moving from near to far. No faces.
shots.narration: 压住压把，从近到远，左右扫。

shots.section_title: 对准火焰根部，左右扫射
shots.scene: 火灭后仍盯着余烬，防止复燃
shots.prompt_en: After the flames go out, the female graduate student keeps watching the embers.
shots.narration: 直到扑灭，再盯住防复燃。

shots.section_title: 一具灭火器只能喷很短时间
shots.scene: 灭火器喷射，旁边计时图标很快走完
shots.prompt_en: An extinguisher sprays while a timer icon beside it quickly runs out. No text.
shots.narration: 一具灭火器只能喷很短时间。
overlay: 一具灭火器只能喷很短时间

shots.section_title: 一具灭火器只能喷很短时间
shots.scene: 粉雾浪费在空中，打叉；对准火根，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Powder wasted in the air is crossed out; powder aimed at the fire base gets a check. No faces.
shots.narration: 别浪费在空中，一开始就对准火根。

shots.section_title: 一具灭火器只能喷很短时间
shots.scene: 铭牌上的喷射时间图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank extinguisher label with a timer icon highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 型号不同时间不同，看铭牌和培训。

shots.section_title: 保持安全距离，站在上风
shots.scene: 离火太近被烤，离火太远喷不到
shots.prompt_en: Left: a figure too close gets heat waves; right: a figure too far, the spray falls short. No faces.
shots.narration: 太近会烤伤，太远喷不到。
overlay: 保持安全距离，站在上风

shots.section_title: 保持安全距离，站在上风
shots.scene: 在有效距离内，由远及近逐步靠近
shots.prompt_en: A figure stands at a safe distance and steps closer as the fire shrinks. No faces.
shots.narration: 保持安全距离，按火势逐步靠近。

shots.section_title: 保持安全距离，站在上风
shots.scene: 风向箭头，人站在上风方向灭火
shots.prompt_en: A wind arrow shows direction; the figure stands upwind of the fire, smoke blowing away. No faces.
shots.narration: 站在上风方向，烟往后飘。

shots.section_title: 保持安全距离，站在上风
shots.scene: 先看清烧的是什么，再选灭火器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks what is burning, then picks the matching extinguisher.
shots.narration: 先认清燃烧物，再选灭火器。

shots.section_title: 背对出口，退路留在身后
shots.scene: 人面向火，背后就是出口门
shots.prompt_en: A figure faces the fire with the exit door directly behind. No faces.
shots.narration: 灭火时背对出口，面向火。
overlay: 背对出口，退路留在身后

shots.section_title: 背对出口，退路留在身后
shots.scene: 火被夹在人和出口之间，打叉
shots.prompt_en: The fire is between a figure and the exit, crossed out with a red X. No faces.
shots.narration: 别让火挡在你和出口之间。

shots.section_title: 背对出口，退路留在身后
shots.scene: 火控制不住，人转身从身后出口撤出
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows and the figure turns and leaves through the exit behind. No faces.
shots.narration: 火控制不住，转身就能撤。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器：防冻伤，防窒息
shots.scene: 提起二氧化碳灭火器，拔销，握住手柄
shots.prompt_en: A person lifts a carbon dioxide extinguisher, pulls the pin and grips the handle, not the horn. No faces.
shots.narration: 二氧化碳灭火器，同样提、拔、握、压。
overlay: 二氧化碳灭火器：防冻伤，防窒息

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器：防冻伤，防窒息
shots.scene: 手握喇叭筒结霜，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bare hand on a frosted horn nozzle is crossed out. No faces.
shots.narration: 喇叭筒极冷，别直接握，会冻伤。

shots.section_title: 二氧化碳灭火器：防冻伤，防窒息
shots.scene: 小房间喷放后，人马上撤出，之后开窗通风
shots.prompt_en: After discharge in a small room, the person leaves at once; later windows are opened.
shots.narration: 小房间喷完先撤出，通风后再进。

shots.section_title: 扑不灭就撤，生命高于财产
shots.scene: 火势变大，小研放下灭火器，招呼大家撤离
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows; the female graduate student puts down the extinguisher and waves everyone out.
shots.narration: 火太大扑不灭，马上让所有人撤离。
overlay: 扑不灭就撤，生命高于财产

shots.section_title: 扑不灭就撤，生命高于财产
shots.scene: 撤离时低姿捂口鼻，走楼梯不坐电梯
shots.prompt_en: People crouch low, cover their mouths and take the stairs; the elevator is crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 低姿捂口鼻，走楼梯，不坐电梯。

shots.section_title: 扑不灭就撤，生命高于财产
shots.scene: 手机拨号界面显示119
shots.prompt_en: A phone dial screen shows 119 being called. No text.
shots.narration: 到安全处拨打119。

shots.section_title: 扑不灭就撤，生命高于财产
shots.scene: 人和仪器放在天平两端，人一端更重
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with a person icon on one side and lab equipment on the other; the person side is heavier. No text.
shots.narration: 生命高于财产，不回头取东西。

shots.section_title: 灭火器的日常检查
shots.scene: 老李拿着检查卡站在灭火器前
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands in front of a wall-mounted extinguisher holding a blank checklist card.
shots.narration: 灭火器要定期检查。

shots.section_title: 灭火器的日常检查
shots.scene: 【实拍】灭火器压力表特写，指针在绿区（本校灭火器，遮挡品牌型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a fire extinguisher pressure gauge with the needle in the green zone.
shots.narration: 压力表指针要在绿区。

shots.section_title: 灭火器的日常检查
shots.scene: 压力表指针在红区，打叉，报修
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge needle in the red zone gets a red X and a repair tag. No text.
shots.narration: 指针在红区，说明压力不够。

shots.section_title: 灭火器的日常检查
shots.scene: 【实拍】保险销、铅封、软管和喷嘴依次特写（本校灭火器，遮挡品牌型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-ups in turn of the safety pin with seal, the hose and the nozzle of an extinguisher.
shots.narration: 看保险销、铅封、软管和喷嘴。

shots.section_title: 灭火器的日常检查
shots.scene: 筒体锈蚀变形、软管开裂的图标，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rusted dented cylinder and a cracked hose, each crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 筒体锈蚀变形、软管开裂，都要报修。

shots.section_title: 灭火器的日常检查
shots.scene: 【实拍】灭火器检查标签和生产日期标记特写（本校灭火器）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of an inspection tag hanging on an extinguisher and its date marking area.
shots.narration: 看有效期，检查后签卡记录。

shots.section_title: 灭火器的日常检查
shots.scene: 推车式灭火器，老李查看车轮和软管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the wheels and hose of a large wheeled fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 推车式的，还要看推车。

shots.section_title: 灭火器的日常检查
shots.scene: 老李发现问题，向王老师报修
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reports a faulty extinguisher to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 周期按学校规定，发现问题就报修。

shots.section_title: 放在明处，不挡不挪，用后更换
shots.scene: 灭火器挂在显眼处，前面通道畅通
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher is mounted in a visible spot with a clear path in front. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器放在显眼、顺手的地方。
overlay: 放在明处，不挡不挪，用后更换

shots.section_title: 放在明处，不挡不挪，用后更换
shots.scene: 灭火器被纸箱挡住，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher hidden behind stacked boxes, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 前面不堆东西，伸手就能拿到。

shots.section_title: 放在明处，不挡不挪，用后更换
shots.scene: 屈膝提起，一手握提把一手握喷管
shots.prompt_en: A person bends the knees to lift the extinguisher, one hand on the handle, one on the hose. No faces.
shots.narration: 屈膝提起，别闪了腰。

shots.section_title: 放在明处，不挡不挪，用后更换
shots.scene: 两人配合拉推车式灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Two people work together to move and operate a wheeled fire extinguisher. No faces.
shots.narration: 大型推车式的，两人配合使用。

shots.section_title: 放在明处，不挡不挪，用后更换
shots.scene: 灭火器被挪去当门挡，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher used as a door stop is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不得挪用、损坏消防器材。

shots.section_title: 放在明处，不挡不挪，用后更换
shots.scene: 用过的灭火器交给老李，换上新的
shots.prompt_en: A used extinguisher is handed to the facility engineer, who mounts a new one.
shots.narration: 用过一次，马上报告更换。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 提、拔、握、压四个图标依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons get green checks one by one. No text.
shots.narration: 提拔握压，对准火根，背对出口。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 压力表、铅封、有效期三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A pressure gauge, a seal and a date tag icon get green checks. No text.
shots.narration: 定期检查，扑不灭就撤。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣把灭火毯挂回墙上，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot hangs a fire blanket back on the wall and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲初起火灾与衣物着火。
